title: Language Generation Models Can Cause Harm: So What Can We Do About It? An Actionable Survey
reasoning: This paper is a survey of strategies to mitigate societal harms in large language models. A core component of this survey involves evaluating and discussing 'machine ethics', 'moral norms', and aligning AI with human values, specifically citing benchmarks and models like Delphi and Hendrycks et al.'s work on moral norms.
